name: keelokit-studio
description: Development and verification tools for the Keelokit Studio Claude Code plugin.

scripts.validate:plugin: claude plugin validate .claude-plugin/plugin.json --strict --json && claude plugin validate .claude-plugin/marketplace.json --strict --json && claude plugin validate commands --strict --json && claude plugin validate skills --strict --json
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run validate:plugin && npm run test:install && npm run test:load
